notes.title: ‘A.I Rising’ officially begins closed beta testing today!
notes.notes:
Explore the future city and construct your dream utopia! 'A.I.Rising' officially begins closed beta testing at 10:30 AM today. To ensure a smooth gaming experience, don't forget to check out the CBT information below before starting your journey!
 
———— CBT Information ————

Time: 10:30 AM March 23, 2023 - 10:00 PM March 25, 2023 (GMT+8)
Platform: Steam
Rule: Use the Key to activate the game and enter
FAQ: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2161490/discussions/0/3828662280421576487/

———— Questionnaire Event ————

To celebrate the first CBT of 'A.I.Rising', we have prepared a special event for you! Fill out the questionnaire and provide feedback on your opinions, suggestions, or ideas about the game. Get a chance to win a $10 Steam gift card! Don't forget to leave your Discord ID and number (e.g. Sharon#7831) at the end of the questionnaire. This will be used as the list of winners and proof of award collection that we will announce later on.

———— Test Notice ————

★ The game is currently under development and does not represent the final quality.
★ If you have any questions or suggestions during the testing, please let us know through the following ways. We will carefully check every suggestion and feedback from players!
CBT Feedback Survey: https://link.ok-joy.com/lp/0unzPC0000.html
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/uG6ueWHfN6

notes.title: A.I. Rising will officially start its closed beta test on March 23rd!
notes.notes:
The First Closed Beta Test for Cyberpunk City-building Game A.I.Rising Falls is on March 23rd!
This Thursday, a world of futuristic fantasy will expose itself to its first players. We are so excited to bring out the test, and hopefully, it’ll inspire us on where and how to improve.
In this game, you’ll able to enjoy a dreamy utopia where all of the settings will be under your control. Fancy buildings like Apartments, Defenses, and Warehouses, as well as interesting gears like weapons, and traps are all in the game, including loyal and reliable NPCs! 
Brick by brick, you’ll upgrade your city and strengthen your skills. We truly hope that you’ll enjoy the thrilling gameplay of attacking and defending cities. So what are you still waiting for? Whether you're a Cyberpunk fan or not, this game will certainly bring you a different experience!
